data_partition.calibration: GOT-10k validation sequence numeric ID modulo 3 equals 1
data_partition.selection: GOT-10k validation sequence numeric ID modulo 3 equals 2
data_partition.confirmation: GOT-10k validation sequence numeric ID modulo 3 equals 0

branch_disagreement_threshold_rule: q0.85 from node-7 passive branch_disagreement_l1 calibration logs only

calibration_schedule.selection_rule: largest calibration AO; exact ties use lower alpha

fixed_policy.signal: mean L1 disagreement over four existing normalized sequence-coordinate and expected-bin-coordinate estimates
fixed_policy.signal_materialization: the four model crop values plus two 4-D branch estimates are appended to the released path's one .tolist transfer; no scalar .item transfer is used
fixed_policy.high_disagreement_action: host-side convex mix of current localization and one-step causal constant-velocity prior, alpha=0.05

selection_gate.run_confirmation_only_if: both AO and FPS requirements are satisfied on selection

b_test_policy: No B_test unless calibration, selection, and confirmation all satisfy the frozen policy gates.
